summary: Implemented 3-layer multi-tenant filtering for activity template queries. All users can now only see global templates plus their organization's templates, enforcing proper scope isolation.

changesApplied.changeMade: Added credentials parameter (Optional[HTTPAuthorizationCredentials]), extracted org_id from Bearer token using session_id_from_token(), passed org_id to list_templates()
changesApplied.reason: Enforces multi-tenant isolation at the API entry point. Unauthenticated requests (no Bearer token) only receive global templates. Authenticated requests receive global + org-specific templates.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: LOW - Backward compatible. Existing unauthenticated calls still work (return global templates). Authenticated calls now properly filtered by org_id.

changesApplied.changeMade: Added org_id parameter to function signature, passed org_id to list_all_templates(), added scope filtering logic (lines 175-187) to filter cached templates by scope and org_id match
changesApplied.reason: Enforces multi-tenant isolation in the action layer for both cache-hit and cache-miss paths. Filters templates with scope='org' to only show templates matching user's org_id. Skips project-scoped templates (future implementation).
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: LOW - Additive change. Existing calls without org_id parameter still work (return global templates only). Cache population now respects org_id filtering from database layer.

changesApplied.changeMade: Added org_id parameter to function signature, implemented conditional WHERE clause in SurrealDB query. If org_id provided: returns global + org-specific templates. If no org_id: returns only global templates.
changesApplied.reason: Enforces multi-tenant isolation at the database query level (source of truth). Prevents unauthorized templates from ever entering the cache or response. This is the primary security boundary.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: MEDIUM - Query change affects all cache-miss scenarios. Added WHERE clause improves security but may impact query performance on large template datasets. MITIGATION: Consider adding index on (scope, org_id) columns.

securityImprovement.before: All users could see ALL templates regardless of organization, exposing proprietary workflows and internal tools
securityImprovement.after: Users can only see global templates + their own organization's templates, enforcing proper multi-tenant isolation

unitTests: Test list_all_templates() with org_id returns filtered results
Test list_all_templates() without org_id returns only global templates
Test list_templates() filters cached templates by scope and org_id
integrationTests: Test GET /v2/activities/templates without Bearer token returns only global templates
Test GET /v2/activities/templates with Bearer token returns global + org templates
Test User A cannot see User B's org-scoped templates
Test cache invalidation preserves org_id filtering
testingRequirements.requiredExtension: Add multi-user query filtering tests to harness (listTemplatesAsOrgA, listTemplatesAsOrgB, verifyIsolation)

performanceConsiderations.databaseQueries: Added WHERE clause may impact query performance on large template datasets
performanceConsiderations.recommendation: Add composite index on (scope, org_id) columns in SurrealDB
performanceConsiderations.cacheStrategy: Cache population now respects org_id filtering, reducing cache pollution from inaccessible templates
performanceConsiderations.impact: LOW - WHERE clause filtering is more efficient than post-query filtering

rippleEffects.upstreamChanges: None - API signature unchanged (credentials parameter is optional)
rippleEffects.downstreamChanges: None - Response schema unchanged (only content filtered)
